title.narrative: ''Compete Ghana'' - Technical Assistance to the Ministry of Trade and Industry in the implementation of the Stepping Stone Economic Partnership Agreement (iEPA) and Related Accompanying Measures (Part 1)

description.narrative: The overall objective of the project of which this contract will be a part of is, in the context of the Ghana beyond aid vision, to improve economic governance and business environment and to maximise the benefits of the EPA for Ghana. 1. Build MoTI's capacity to comply with the commitments of the EPA and make full use of its provisions through effective implementation of the EPA-AMS; 2. Support MoTI for the setting-up of institutional requirements as foreseen in the agreement: joint EPA Committee and Ghana's inter-institutional committee on EPA; 3. Support MoTI for the monitoring and evaluation of the impact of the EPA implementation with the involvement of the private sector; 4. Build the capacity of MoTI to conduct sensitisation and awareness activities, including public/private dialogue and dialogue with civil society.

title.narrative: To improve economic governance and business environment and to maximise the benefits of the EPA for Ghana

description.narrative: Ghana has been actively working to enhance its economic governance and business environment, particularly with the aim of capitalizing on the Economic Partnership Agreement (EPA) with the European Union. The country has adopted several reforms in recent years to stabilize the economy and create a more favorable environment for business and investment. These reforms are also aimed at fostering longterm structural transformation. Ghana has emphasized digitalization in sectors like banking and retail, agricultural modernization, and industrial policy adjustments to increase local processing and highervalue exports, particularly in sectors like mining and agriculture. Additionally, improving public financial management and debt restructuring efforts have been central in addressing economic vulnerabilities, particularly in response to recent global financial pressures.

title.narrative: Build MoTIs capacity to comply with the commitments of the EPA and make full use of its provisions through effective implementation of the EPAAMS

description.narrative: The Ministry of Trade and Industry (MoTI) in Ghana has undertaken several initiatives to enhance its capacity, aiming to foster economic growth, improve the business environment, and effectively implement trade agreements such as the Economic Partnership Agreement (EPA) with the European Union. The project has enhanced the capacity of MoTI to develop export opportunities for private sector operators through the capacity enhancement of GEPA ability to train its membership base on exports to EU (Training curricula and ecommerce platform), and developing a GhanaEU early warning mechanism

title.narrative: Support MoTI for the settingup of institutional requirements as foreseen in the agreement: joint EPA Committee and Ghanas interinstitutional committee on EPA

description.narrative: The project assisted the MoTI in setting up a baseline study for EPA, and impact assessment of the Agreement on the private sector, a risk assessment overview of the EPA on selected Ghanaian sectors. Finally the project assisted MoTI in the preparation of the first National Evaluative report that forms the basis for discussions at the EUGhana Joint committee meetings
